description: Simulates an IBM App Connect flow that reads validated transactions from the core COBOL system and creates/updates Salesforce records.

field_mappings.business_note: SIGN CONVENTION: a NEGATIVE amount from the core system is how a refund (money going out to the customer) is represented. Salesforce's 'Process Refund' flow only fires when Refund_Amount__c is negative. If the core system starts rejecting negative amounts, no Refund__c record is ever created, and the customer-facing refund never happens -- with no error visible on the Salesforce side, because from Salesforce's point of view, nothing ever arrived.

trigger_condition: Only records with STATUS = 'VALID' in validated-output.dat are sent to Salesforce. A record with STATUS = 'REJECTED' never reaches this mapping at all -- this is exactly why the after-fix change is invisible from the Salesforce side.
